'''Vendsyssel Forenede Fodboldklubber''' is a professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Hjørring]], Denmark. The team competes in the [[Danish 1st Division]], the second tier of the [[Danish football league system]]. The club plays home matches at [[Hjørring Stadion|Nord Energi Arena]], which has a capacity of 7,500.<ref name="stadion" /> The club is playing on a license from Hjørring IF, which used to belong to [[FC Hjørring]]. The club is a cooperation between Hjørring IF and [[Frederikshavn fI]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://fchjoerring.dk/nyheder?id=367|archive-url=https://archive.today/20130703175426/http://fchjoerring.dk/nyheder?id=367|url-status=dead|archive-date=July 3, 2013|title=FC Hjørring skifter navn til Vendsyssel FF|publisher=FC Hjørring|access-date=August 9, 2013|date=June 24, 2013|language=da}}</ref>"}}
